description: qFoldIT Toolbelt for UNIGINE 2 / UNIGINE 2 Sim — plugin registry. Format mirrors UEFN Toolbelt's registry.json.
transport: external mcp_server.py (stdio) -> HTTP 127.0.0.1:8766 -> ToolbeltListener.cs (in-Editor). Companion to, not a replacement for, UNIGINE's official MCPBridge Plugin.

plugins.name: Asset Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: List, instantiate, and find project .node/.mesh/.mat assets by extension and name.

plugins.name: Audio Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: ObjectSound source setup, one-shot playback, listener node, volume control.

plugins.name: Camera Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Player/camera creation, dependency-free follow, clipping, FOV, screenshots.

plugins.name: Component Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Reflection-based generic add/remove/get/set/list for C# Components.

plugins.name: Console & Build Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Run console commands, read console variables, save the world.

plugins.name: Lighting Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Create lights, set environment/fog, trigger GI reload, apply full lighting presets.

plugins.name: Material Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: 12 material presets, bulk swap by name match, team-color split, preset listing.

plugins.name: Measurement Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Distance between nodes, per-node bounds, full-world bounds.

plugins.name: Navigation Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: NavigationMesh bake, agents, obstacles, runtime destinations (Navigation add-on).

plugins.name: CodeGen Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Generates a WorldLogic component with real, bindable node references for named world nodes.

plugins.name: Node Workflow Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Save/reload/variant/XML-export workflow for .node assets — UNIGINE's prefab-equivalent.

plugins.name: Particle Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: ObjectParticles spawning from assets, emission rate, color, stop control.

plugins.name: Physics Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Rigid bodies, collision shapes, physics materials, raycasts, global gravity.

plugins.name: Procedural Placement & Arena
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: 8 geometric placement patterns (grid, circle, arc, spiral, line, wave, helix, radial) plus a symmetrical arena generator.

plugins.name: Project Setup
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Standard folder scaffold plus a boilerplate GameManager WorldLogic class.

plugins.name: Scene Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Spawn, transform, clone, delete, parent, list, and find nodes in the loaded world.

plugins.name: Stamp Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Save a selection as a reusable stamp; place it anywhere with rotation; list saved stamps.

plugins.name: Tags & Layers Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Free-text tag registry plus real IntersectionMask-backed named layers.

plugins.name: UAG Bridge Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Validates and realizes qFoldIT Universal Assembly Graphs by dispatching to this toolbelt's own registered tools — the Universal World Interface adapter connecting UNIGINE 2 to the rest of the qFoldIT stack.

plugins.name: UI Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Widget-based UI: buttons, labels, panels, sliders, tracked by a lightweight name registry.

plugins.name: Editor Utility Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Batch rename and basic Engine/world info reporting.

plugins.name: World Management Tools
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: New/load/save-as/reload/info for the single active world.

plugins.name: World State Export
plugins.author: qFoldIT
plugins.description: Exports the full world node graph (names, types, transforms, parents) to JSON for AI context.
